raw_segments.text: It was not much more than three-quarters of a mile from the town to the monastery.
Alyosha walked quickly along the road, at that hour deserted.
It was almost night, and too dark to see anything clearly at thirty paces ahead.
A figure came into sight under a solitary willow at the crossroads.
As soon as Alyosha reached the crossroads, the figure moved out and rushed at him, shouting
Alyosha walked into the crossroads, shouting savagely.
